name: Voss ChromeVeil Cosmetic Interface Glove
description:
A precision-fitted glove designed to cosmetically cover chrome hands and forearm augmentations while maintaining full digital functionality. Exterior is matte synth-skin in a wide range of melanin tones and undertones, surface-textured to approximate pore structure at close range. The palm and finger interiors are lined with signal-transparent graphene mesh that allows BCI handshake and capacitive surface interaction without removal.

Cutaway options at the fingertips are available for users who need unmediated tactile feedback. The wrist seal bonds magnetically to most standard chrome forearm flanges, creating a seamless silhouette under a suit cuff.
functionality: Allows capacitive touch and BCI handshake through the glove material; magnetic wrist seal bonds to chrome forearm flanges; optional fingertip cutaways; signal-transparent palm enables device interaction without removal.
what_it_says: You have chrome but you're choosing when the world sees it.
worn_by: junior corporate executives with arm augments
upwardly mobile Tier 3 workers managing optics
story_hooks: A client insists their negotiating partner is fully biological — but someone noticed the magnetic seam at the wrist cuff during a handshake.
A counterfeit run of these gloves uses non-signal-transparent film, causing BCI dropout at critical moments during high-stakes meetings.
An investigator needs to identify a suspect by their chrome hand model — but the ChromeVeil obscures the manufacturer markings entirely.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, second-skin glove that creates the illusion of unaugmented human hands. Sits flush against chrome limbs with zero visible seams or tech. The matte finish mimics natural skin tone with subtle undertone variation. When worn, appears as ordinary skin rather than prosthetic or tech—the goal is invisibility within professional contexts.
physical_description.fit: Precision-fitted, compression-grade contact with the underlying chrome. Conforms exactly to the wearer's augmented hand and forearm geometry. Wrist seal magnetically anchors to chrome flanges for a seamless transition under clothing.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte synth-skin exterior (melanin-matched to individual wearer); signal-transparent graphene mesh lining in palm and fingers
physical_description.texture: Exterior: micro-textured to approximate natural skin pore structure at close inspection. Interior: smooth graphene mesh that conducts without friction.
physical_description.color_scheme: Customizable to individual melanin tone and undertone (warm, cool, or neutral). Typically offered in 40+ shade variations. Matte finish eliminates shine.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic wrist seal bonding to standard chrome forearm flanges. No visible fasteners or zippers.
distinctive_features: Pore-structure surface texturing for tactile realism
Signal-transparent graphene mesh allows BCI handshake and capacitive touch without removal
Optional fingertip cutaway zones for unmediated tactile feedback
Seamless wrist integration with chrome augmentation
Voss Adaptive Systems branding (subtle embossed logo on inner wrist)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury. Cost and customization mark this as corpo-grade. Sub-tiers cannot afford cosmetic augmentation overlay.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmented professionals who operate in corpo boardrooms, medical facilities, or formal settings where visible chrome reads as unprofessional or creates social friction. Signals wealth, discretion, and integration into mainstream society despite augmentation.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly worn. These are precision instruments replaced regularly. Wear shows as minor surface dulling on high-contact areas (thumb, index finger, palm). Never patched or salvaged.
